$comment: Definition of done. Fill criteria and reviewed verify commands before starting. check_features.py freezes id/title/acceptance/verify during a run; only passes and evidence may change. Evidence is a nonempty project-relative artifact written by verify.sh and containing the run id (HARNESS_RUN_ID) - not a command, not a claim, not an agent-written note. The feature checker never executes verify strings; the reviewed verify.sh does.
